disclaimer: Entertainment and experimental investigation only. Not a prediction. Not contact with the dead. Not medical, legal, or financial advice.

decks.name: Field Oracle
decks.tagline: Plates about how you look at a question.
notes: Each plate is a prompt about how you are looking.

cards.name: Dead Air
cards.meaningCore: Things have gone quiet. Don't rush to fill the quiet. Wait.
cards.labNote: Silence is a real result. It counts as data.
cards.meaningReversed: You are filling the quiet too fast. Give it one more moment before you invent what the quiet means.

cards.name: Threshold
cards.meaningCore: You are standing between two sides. Say which side you are actually on before you move.
cards.labNote: Fix the location first, then decide what it means.
cards.meaningReversed: You are treating the doorway as the destination. Pick a side and step, or stay.

cards.name: Residual
cards.meaningCore: Something leftover from before is still coloring this. Try to tell old feeling apart from what is happening now.
cards.labNote: Contamination check: work out what belongs to an earlier sitting.
cards.meaningReversed: You are treating yesterday's leftover as if it were happening tonight.

cards.name: Contamination
cards.meaningCore: Something else is mixing in: your mood, the room, the last question. Name it so it does not pretend to be the answer.
cards.meaningReversed: You already know what is mixing in, and you are pretending it is a message.

cards.name: Observer
cards.meaningCore: You are part of this. Write down what you hoped to see, so you can tell hope apart from what showed up.
cards.labNote: Observer bias is on the table.
cards.meaningReversed: You are hiding from what you hoped to see.

cards.name: Handshake
cards.meaningCore: This is only a hello. Ask one clear question and wait.
cards.labNote: Toolkit echo: say hello, then listen.
cards.meaningReversed: You are demanding an answer instead of starting a conversation.

cards.name: Vigil
cards.meaningCore: Stay with this a little longer. Time spent watching is the work.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep starting over because sitting still feels empty.

cards.name: Knock
cards.meaningCore: Something small just happened. Count it. Don't turn one moment into a whole story yet.
cards.labNote: Log it as an event and leave the omens out.
cards.meaningReversed: You heard one small thing and already wrote a story around it.

cards.name: Radio Hop
cards.meaningCore: A little piece came through, then moved on. Notice the piece. Don't force it into a full sentence.
cards.labNote: Spirit Box analog: hop, clip, release.
cards.meaningReversed: You are stitching leftover scraps into a speech that was not there.

cards.name: Barometer
cards.meaningCore: The room changed, or you did. Check the simple stuff first: tired, hungry, weather, noise.
cards.meaningReversed: You skipped the simple cause and jumped to a big meaning.

cards.name: False Color
cards.meaningCore: What you are looking at has been dressed up. Ask what it looked like before the extra color.
cards.labNote: SLS / depth analog: rendering is not proof.
cards.meaningReversed: You are reading the extra color as if it were the thing itself.

cards.name: SLS Figure
cards.meaningCore: This looks like a person. Treat it as a maybe until it happens again.
cards.labNote: A pose estimate. There is no person in there.
cards.meaningReversed: You named it too fast.

cards.name: Magnet Spike
cards.meaningCore: A sudden spike. Notice how long it lasted and what moved in the room.
cards.meaningReversed: You gave the spike a voice it does not have.

cards.name: White Noise
cards.meaningCore: There is a lot of background noise. Listen for a change in it. Don't hunt for a voice in the hiss.
cards.labNote: This is the carrier. The content would be something else.
cards.meaningReversed: You are hearing shapes in the noise because you want to.

cards.name: Receipt
cards.meaningCore: Keep the proof of how the plates were shuffled. You can check this later.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a secret method. There is not one.

cards.name: Follow-up
cards.meaningCore: This is not finished until you come back and see whether it actually showed up in your day.
cards.meaningReversed: You took a reading and you will never check it.

cards.name: Inconclusive
cards.meaningCore: This one will not force a yes or a no. Sit with the question, or draw again.
cards.labNote: The Instrument rule, in oracle form.
cards.meaningReversed: You are squeezing a yes or no out of a maybe.

cards.name: Calibration
cards.meaningCore: Check how you are working before you read the result. This plate is about the method, and it says nothing about your future.
cards.meaningReversed: You treated a setup step as a prediction.

cards.name: Baseline
cards.meaningCore: Start with what things do when you ask nothing. That quiet is the starting point.
cards.meaningReversed: You skipped the starting point and jumped to the effect.

cards.name: Spike
cards.meaningCore: A peak. Notice how wide it is. A sharp jump is not a whole story.
cards.meaningReversed: You turned a sharp jump into a personality.

cards.name: Fade
cards.meaningCore: Whatever was coming through is leaving. Don't chase it with a louder question.
cards.meaningReversed: You are shouting after something that already closed.

cards.name: Static
cards.meaningCore: Noise on the line. It is not a whisper until it happens again.
cards.meaningReversed: You turned noise into a name.

cards.name: Carrier
cards.meaningCore: This is the background that lets other things be heard. Don't confuse the background with the message.
cards.meaningReversed: You fell in love with the tool.

cards.name: Mic
cards.meaningCore: What you said is in the mix. Play it back before you credit someone else.
cards.meaningReversed: You did not listen to yourself.

cards.name: Torch
cards.meaningCore: Light changes what you see. Notice whether you turned a light on.
cards.meaningReversed: You changed the lighting and called it a sign.

cards.name: Grid
cards.meaningCore: Get specific. Where, exactly.
cards.meaningReversed: You are being vague on purpose.

cards.name: Pose
cards.meaningCore: This looks like a body. Write down what you actually saw, and leave the ghost story out of it.
cards.meaningReversed: You skipped what you saw and wrote a spirit.

cards.name: Depth
cards.meaningCore: Is this close or far. Get that straight before you decide what it means.
cards.meaningReversed: You flattened a real scene into a vibe.

cards.name: Drift
cards.meaningCore: You wandered off the question. Name the wander and come back.
cards.meaningReversed: You are calling wandering a guide.

cards.name: Echo
cards.meaningCore: You are hearing yourself come back. Look at the question you asked.
cards.meaningReversed: You wanted a stranger and got a mirror.

cards.name: Silence
cards.meaningCore: Nothing happened. That is allowed. It still counts.
cards.meaningReversed: You will not accept a quiet result.

cards.name: Contact
cards.meaningCore: A possible link. Keep it as a maybe until it happens again the same way.
cards.meaningReversed: You already decided it was real.

cards.name: Distance
cards.meaningCore: You are too close or too far. Move your body. Don't just rethink it from where you stand.
cards.meaningReversed: You are theorizing instead of changing where you stand.

cards.name: Timing
cards.meaningCore: When did this happen, relative to the question. Order matters.
cards.meaningReversed: You mashed the timeline together.

cards.name: Question
cards.meaningCore: The reading is only as good as the question. Write it once more, more clearly.
cards.meaningReversed: Your question is a trap.

cards.name: Instrument
cards.meaningCore: This plate is about the method itself. This is entertainment. Nothing here is answering as a spirit, and nothing here predicts anything.
cards.labNote: Brand card for the Field Oracle.
cards.meaningReversed: You asked the tool to become a fortune. It will not.

cards.name: Owl
cards.meaningCore: Slow down. Watch longer. Wait for something to move before you ask the next question.
cards.meaningReversed: You wanted a wise mascot. Look at the watching itself.

cards.name: Moth
cards.meaningCore: You are circling the brightest thing, even if it is the wrong thing. Name the lamp you keep flying toward.
cards.labNote: Moths go to light. That is the whole of it, with no omen attached.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep repeating an attraction that burns.

cards.name: Crow
cards.meaningCore: Something nearby changed. Look around, then write down what you saw.
cards.labNote: A crow's alarm call. It has never meant a death.
cards.meaningReversed: You brought in a superstition this set does not carry.

cards.name: Fox
cards.meaningCore: Work the edges of the question before you go at the middle of it.
cards.meaningReversed: You are being clever instead of clear.

cards.name: Bat
cards.meaningCore: Send a small signal and listen for what comes back.
cards.meaningReversed: You are talking too loud to hear the return.

cards.name: Cat
cards.meaningCore: Sitting still is allowed. You do not have to perform.
cards.labNote: A companion animal, and no one's familiar.
cards.meaningReversed: You want this reading to hunt for you.

cards.name: Dog
cards.meaningCore: Something arrived at the door. Who is it, and what changed.
cards.labNote: An alert. Skip the sermon about loyalty.
cards.meaningReversed: You are demanding loyalty from a picture.

cards.name: Rat
cards.meaningCore: Follow a path that already exists. You do not have to invent a new one.
cards.meaningReversed: You are disgusted and missing the map.

cards.name: Deer
cards.meaningCore: Small moves feel huge from here. Soften how you come in.
cards.meaningReversed: You crashed in too loud.

cards.name: Snake
cards.meaningCore: Leave the old skin behind. Don't put it back on.
cards.labNote: A molt. There is nothing evil in it.
cards.meaningReversed: You are using this as a villain.

cards.name: Spider
cards.meaningCore: The net is already up. Use the one you built instead of spinning a new one.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep spinning a new web instead of using the one that is up.

cards.name: Wolf
cards.meaningCore: The question is bigger than this room. Step back and look at the whole range.
cards.meaningReversed: You shrank a pack problem to a personal mood.

cards.name: Raven
cards.meaningCore: Pick the thing up. Turn it over. Look at the object. Skip the story around the bird.
cards.meaningReversed: You romanticized the bird and skipped the object.

cards.name: Toad
cards.meaningCore: Stay low. Stay with the floor. Skip the sky story.
cards.meaningReversed: You wanted a prince. Stay with the floor.

cards.name: Beetle
cards.meaningCore: You are carrying your house with you. What could you set down.
cards.meaningReversed: You are calling armor a personality.

cards.name: Horse
cards.meaningCore: This will take real effort over a stretch of time.
cards.meaningReversed: You want speed without the work.

cards.name: Goat
cards.meaningCore: The steep route is available. The easy path is not the only one.
cards.meaningReversed: You are butting instead of climbing.

cards.name: Hare
cards.meaningCore: Your first move may be to run. Name that before you judge it.
cards.meaningReversed: You already ran, and now you are asking why this feels empty.

cards.name: Mouse
cards.meaningCore: The small gap is the whole point. The detail you skipped is the reading.
cards.meaningReversed: You only want large events.

cards.name: Hawk
cards.meaningCore: Pick one question. Drop the rest.
cards.meaningReversed: You are scanning the whole sky.

cards.name: Wren
cards.meaningCore: A lot of sound can come from a small thing. Loud is not the same as true.
cards.meaningReversed: You mistook loud for true.

cards.name: Ant
cards.meaningCore: Look for the line of crumbs you already laid. Follow that.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a solo miracle.

cards.name: Fly
cards.meaningCore: This will not settle. If it will not sit, change rooms.
cards.meaningReversed: You are the fly.

cards.name: Cricket
cards.meaningCore: Let this run on the clock. Skip the drama.
cards.meaningReversed: You want lyrics in a beat.

cards.name: Bee
cards.meaningCore: Do the next small load of work.
cards.meaningReversed: You want honey without the flights.

cards.name: Fish
cards.meaningCore: Look under the obvious surface.
cards.meaningReversed: You will not get wet.

cards.name: Frog
cards.meaningCore: Send one call. Then wait.
cards.meaningReversed: You are filling the pond with noise.

cards.name: Otter
cards.meaningCore: If this has gone grim, loosen one rule. Play is allowed to be useful.
cards.labNote: Play used as a method, which is more than being cute.
cards.meaningReversed: You used play to avoid the question.

cards.name: Mill moth
cards.meaningCore: Something in storage is waking. Check the box you have not opened.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep buying new tools instead of opening the old notes.

cards.name: Sheep
cards.meaningCore: Is this your question, or the room's.
cards.meaningReversed: You handed the reading to the crowd.

cards.name: Pig
cards.meaningCore: Dig. The useful part is in the dirt you did not want to touch.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a clean omen.

cards.name: Rooster
cards.meaningCore: The night is over. Write down what you have and stop.
cards.meaningReversed: You are forcing overtime.

cards.name: Luna
cards.meaningCore: A rare visitor. Log it once. Don't inflate it into a destiny.
cards.meaningReversed: You are building a religion out of one sighting.

cards.name: Vulture
cards.meaningCore: Finish the leftover work. Clean what is already done.
cards.labNote: A scavenger doing its job. It never doomed anyone.
cards.meaningReversed: You called this death because you were afraid of chores.

cards.name: Atlas
cards.meaningCore: This is heavy and slow. Plan for weight. It will not dart.
cards.meaningReversed: You wanted agility.

cards.name: Nightjar
cards.meaningCore: It is already there and you missed it. Look again at the same patch.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep changing the scene.

decks.name: Residual Objects
notes: Things you might find in a house.

cards.name: Key
cards.meaningCore: A key gets you in. It is not the room. Ask which lock you are really standing at.
cards.meaningReversed: You collect keys and never open the door.

cards.name: Bell
cards.meaningCore: Mark the start on purpose. The event has a beginning.
cards.meaningReversed: You are waiting for someone else to ring it.

cards.name: Photograph
cards.meaningCore: This is a still picture of the past. Don't interview it as if it could answer.
cards.meaningReversed: You are talking to a picture.

cards.name: Locket
cards.meaningCore: This is closed on purpose. You may not be owed the inside.
cards.meaningReversed: You are prying.

cards.name: Ring
cards.meaningCore: You may be back at the start.
cards.meaningReversed: You are calling a loop fate.

cards.name: Watch
cards.meaningCore: Look at the clock. How long has this actually been.
cards.meaningReversed: You lost the clock.

cards.name: Book
cards.meaningCore: Read the page in front of you instead of the one you wish someone had written.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a new story.

cards.name: Letter
cards.meaningCore: Who is this actually for.
cards.meaningReversed: You opened mail that is not yours. Stop.

cards.name: Candle
cards.meaningCore: This has a burn time. End it when the time is up.
cards.meaningReversed: You will sit until nothing is left and call that devotion.

cards.name: Lantern
cards.meaningCore: You are responsible for the beam. Carry it.
cards.meaningReversed: You want the room to light itself.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.meaningCore: Check your own face before you name what you saw.
cards.meaningReversed: You will not look.

cards.name: Coin
cards.meaningCore: What are you paying, and what do you think you bought.
cards.labNote: Object: exchange. No money spell here.
cards.meaningReversed: You asked a money fortune. This set will not do that.

cards.name: Knife
cards.meaningCore: Cut one thing. Leave the rest whole.
cards.meaningReversed: You are slashing at everything.

cards.name: Chair
cards.meaningCore: Sit. Standing over it is not always better.
cards.meaningReversed: You refuse to sit with it.

cards.name: Door
cards.meaningCore: A closed door is information. Knock or leave. Don't pick at the frame all night.
cards.meaningReversed: You are loitering.

cards.name: Window
cards.meaningCore: You can see the other side. You cannot pass through yet.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep trying to climb through a view.

cards.name: Dust
cards.meaningCore: Dust settles when you stop stirring. Stop stirring.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep stirring to feel alive.

cards.name: Footprint
cards.meaningCore: A print. Size, direction, how many. Then stop inventing the walker.
cards.meaningReversed: You wrote a biography from one print.

cards.name: Tape
cards.meaningCore: A recording exists. Play it twice before you decide what it said.
cards.meaningReversed: You heard it once and locked the story.

cards.name: Radio
cards.meaningCore: Tune to one station. Don't surf every meaning at once.
cards.meaningReversed: You want every station at once.

cards.name: Battery
cards.meaningCore: Charge is finite. If you are empty, stop.
cards.meaningReversed: You are running on fumes.

cards.name: Wire
cards.meaningCore: Trace the links you installed. You may have forgotten you plugged this in.
cards.meaningReversed: You think the link is mysterious because you forgot you made it.

cards.name: Glass
cards.meaningCore: This can show you something and it can crack. Handle people carefully.
cards.meaningReversed: You are being careless with people.

cards.name: Thread
cards.meaningCore: A thin connection. Don't hang a life on it.
cards.meaningReversed: You overloaded a thread.

cards.name: Button
cards.meaningCore: Finish a small closure.
cards.meaningReversed: You left everything unbuttoned and called it openness.

cards.name: Comb
cards.meaningCore: Separate the strands. Stop telling a story about the knot.
cards.meaningReversed: You like the tangle.

cards.name: Shoe
cards.meaningCore: The next action is physical. Take a step.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a vision instead of a step.

cards.name: Glove
cards.meaningCore: Use a careful way to handle a hot thing.
cards.meaningReversed: You touched it bare and now blame the object.

cards.name: Hat
cards.meaningCore: Which role are you wearing in this reading.
cards.meaningReversed: You mixed roles.

cards.name: Pin
cards.meaningCore: One small hold may be enough.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a spike instead of a pin.

cards.name: Map
cards.meaningCore: A map is only the route. You still have to walk the ground.
cards.meaningReversed: You are collecting maps.

cards.name: Diary
cards.meaningCore: Write this down in boring prose.
cards.meaningReversed: You want the plates to journal for you.

cards.name: Clock
cards.meaningCore: An hour has a number. Stop when it is done.
cards.meaningReversed: You will not stop.

cards.name: Lamp
cards.meaningCore: This lights one patch and leaves the rest of the house dark. Work the patch you can see.
cards.meaningReversed: You want floodlights.

cards.name: Table
cards.meaningCore: Put the question on the table, physically if you have to.
cards.meaningReversed: The question is still only in your head.

cards.name: Print
cards.meaningCore: Is this original, or a reprint of last week's reading.
cards.meaningReversed: You did not notice the reprint.

cards.name: Attic
cards.meaningCore: Look above the room you are in. The unused top of the house is in play.
cards.meaningReversed: You stored something up there and forgot it.

cards.name: Basement
cards.meaningCore: Look under the floor you are standing on.
cards.meaningReversed: You will not go down.

cards.name: Hallway
cards.meaningCore: This is a passage. Keep moving.
cards.meaningReversed: You moved in to a hallway.

cards.name: Kitchen
cards.meaningCore: This is where things get fed. What needs feeding, and who is hungry.
cards.meaningReversed: You came to be served.

cards.name: Bedroom
cards.meaningCore: This is for rest. The question may be asking you to sleep on it.
cards.meaningReversed: You brought the whole house into bed.

cards.name: Stairs
cards.meaningCore: You are between floors. Name the floor you are leaving and the one you are going to.
cards.meaningReversed: You are lingering on the stairs.

cards.name: Landing
cards.meaningCore: A pause between floors. You can stop here for a breath, then go.
cards.meaningReversed: You made a camp on a landing.

cards.name: Porch
cards.meaningCore: You are almost in. Decide whether to knock.
cards.meaningReversed: You are lingering on the porch.

cards.name: Garden
cards.meaningCore: Something here is tended. Ask who tends it, and what they want.
cards.meaningReversed: You walked through a garden as if it were wild.

cards.name: Barn
cards.meaningCore: This is a work building. Tools, hay, animals. What job is waiting.
cards.meaningReversed: You came for atmosphere.

cards.name: Well
cards.meaningCore: Something is down a long way. You will need a rope, or you will leave it.
cards.meaningReversed: You leaned too far.

cards.name: Field
cards.meaningCore: Too much sky. Pick a fence line.
cards.meaningReversed: You want the whole horizon.

cards.name: Forest
cards.meaningCore: You cannot see the whole wood. Mark a tree and keep it in sight.
cards.meaningReversed: You are lost on purpose.

cards.name: River
cards.meaningCore: A current is moving whether you like it or not. Get in, get out, or walk the bank. Pick one.
cards.meaningReversed: You are fighting the current from the middle.

cards.name: Bridge
cards.meaningCore: You are crossing. Don't look down the whole time. Get to the other side.
cards.meaningReversed: You stopped in the middle.

cards.name: Tunnel
cards.meaningCore: There is no way around this one. The dark ends if you keep walking.
cards.meaningReversed: You stopped in the middle and called it insight.

cards.name: Chapel
cards.meaningCore: Drop the volume of the question.
cards.labNote: Place: hush. It belongs to no church.
cards.meaningReversed: You came for spectacle.

cards.name: Graveyard
cards.meaningCore: Do not use this reading to ask after people you have lost.
cards.meaningReversed: That question does not belong here.

cards.name: Hospital
cards.meaningCore: This set will not do medical advice. If this is about health, stop and ask a person who can help.
cards.meaningReversed: You asked a health fortune. Stop.

cards.name: Prison
cards.meaningCore: Name what is locked, and who holds the key.
cards.meaningReversed: You like the lock.

cards.name: School
cards.meaningCore: You are a student in this reading. Drop the urge to pronounce.
cards.meaningReversed: You came to teach the plates.

cards.name: Library
cards.meaningCore: Look up what you already wrote.
cards.meaningReversed: You will not read your own notes.

cards.name: Mansion
cards.meaningCore: Too many rooms. Pick one wing.
cards.meaningReversed: You want to live in every room.

cards.name: Cabin
cards.meaningCore: Shrink the question to a cabin-sized next act.
cards.meaningReversed: You brought mansion problems to a cabin.

cards.name: Path
cards.meaningCore: Others used this route. You can still walk a new one, but say so.
cards.meaningReversed: You think you invented the trail.

cards.name: Gate
cards.meaningCore: Ask who opened this, and whether you should go through.
cards.meaningReversed: You kicked it.

cards.name: Corner
cards.meaningCore: Check the blind corner. Then leave it.
cards.meaningReversed: You are hiding in it.

cards.name: Doorway
cards.meaningCore: You are in a frame. Other people can see you. Be aware of that.
cards.meaningReversed: You thought you were invisible.

cards.name: Threshold stone
cards.meaningCore: One step is the whole thing. Take it, or don't.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep rehearsing the step.

cards.name: Cellar
cards.meaningCore: Cold storage. What should stay down there for now.
cards.meaningReversed: You brought it upstairs too soon.

cards.name: Parlor
cards.meaningCore: Are you performing this reading.
cards.meaningReversed: You wanted an audience.

cards.name: Mine
cards.meaningCore: This will cost. Know the cost before you dig.
cards.meaningReversed: You want ore without the shaft.

cards.name: Mill
cards.meaningCore: Slow, repeated, noisy work. That may be the job.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a finished bag of flour.

cards.name: Cottage
cards.meaningCore: Scale the life-question down to a cottage-sized next act.
cards.meaningReversed: You inflated it.

cards.name: Night landing
cards.meaningCore: A dark pause between floors. Don't invent a figure on the stairs.
cards.meaningReversed: You filled the dark with a story.

cards.name: Hearth
cards.meaningCore: Where is the actual center of heat in this house.
cards.meaningReversed: You keep standing in a cold room asking why you are cold.

decks.name: Signal
notes: Pictures borrowed from radios and meters. Still entertainment.

cards.name: Dead carrier
cards.meaningCore: The line is open and empty. That is a real result. Don't fill it.
cards.meaningReversed: You filled it.

cards.name: Hop
cards.meaningCore: The station changed. Catch the little piece and let it go.
cards.meaningReversed: You glued fragments into a speech.

cards.name: Static
cards.meaningCore: This is hash unless the same shape happens again.
cards.meaningReversed: You heard a name in hash.

cards.name: Carrier tone
cards.meaningCore: The system is on. That is not a message.
cards.meaningReversed: You worshipped the on-light.

cards.name: Peak
cards.meaningCore: A short peak. Notice how wide it is and what caused it.
cards.meaningReversed: You assigned it a speaker.

cards.name: Fade
cards.meaningCore: It is fading. Let it go.
cards.meaningReversed: You chased it by turning the volume up.

cards.name: Rap
cards.meaningCore: A single rap. Count it. Don't interpret the first one.
cards.meaningReversed: You wrote a sentence from one rap.

cards.name: Sweep
cards.meaningCore: A scan. You will miss most of it. That is how a scan works.
cards.meaningReversed: You want to hold every frequency.

cards.name: Whisper band
cards.meaningCore: This is very quiet. Lean in, or admit you cannot hear it.
cards.meaningReversed: You pretended you heard it.

cards.name: Burst
cards.meaningCore: A short burst. Don't stretch it into a paragraph.
cards.meaningReversed: You padded a packet into a paragraph.

cards.name: Noise floor
cards.meaningCore: Anything under this floor is not a signal.
cards.meaningReversed: You are mining the floor.

cards.name: Clip
cards.meaningCore: The input went too loud. Turn down. The distortion is yours.
cards.meaningReversed: You kept the distortion because it sounded haunted.

cards.name: Gain
cards.meaningCore: Volume is a choice. What did you turn up, and why.
cards.meaningReversed: You hid the knob.

cards.name: Band
cards.meaningCore: Stay in this slice. Don't make the whole spectrum about you.
cards.meaningReversed: You want the whole spectrum to be about you.

cards.name: Scan
cards.meaningCore: One pass. Then stop and write it down.
cards.meaningReversed: You will scan until you hear things that are not there.

cards.name: Hold
cards.meaningCore: Hold this. Don't hop away just because it is uncomfortable.
cards.meaningReversed: You hopped.

cards.name: Skip
cards.meaningCore: Skip this one. Not every burst is for this reading.
cards.meaningReversed: You treated a skip as rejection.

cards.name: Tune
cards.meaningCore: A small adjustment to what you already have. You do not need to start over.
cards.meaningReversed: You bought another tool.

cards.name: Drift
cards.meaningCore: The tune walked off. Bring it back, or end.
cards.meaningReversed: You followed it off a cliff.

cards.name: Return
cards.meaningCore: This is an echo of what you just said. Check the last thing you said.
cards.meaningReversed: You want a stranger.

cards.name: Harmonic
cards.meaningCore: This is the same source, heard higher up. Don't count echoes as extra voices.
cards.labNote: Signal: an echo of the tone you already have.
cards.meaningReversed: You counted echoes of one tone as separate voices.

cards.name: Beat
cards.meaningCore: Two things are running at once. Find the second one.
cards.meaningReversed: You merged them.

cards.name: Pulse
cards.meaningCore: An interval. Measure it.
cards.meaningReversed: You felt it and skipped the clock.

cards.name: Click
cards.meaningCore: A click. Check the chair, the heater, the house, before you name it.
cards.meaningReversed: You skipped the ordinary cause.

cards.name: Hiss
cards.meaningCore: Air hiss. Check the mic and the window.
cards.meaningReversed: You named it a whisper.

cards.name: Hum
cards.meaningCore: The building is in the recording. That hum is the house.
cards.meaningReversed: You called the house-hum a choir.

cards.name: Pure tone
cards.meaningCore: A pure tone is often one you made. Check the app.
cards.meaningReversed: You forgot the app makes tones.

cards.name: Blank
cards.meaningCore: Nothing. Write it down. Don't throw the reading away.
cards.meaningReversed: You will not keep a nothing.

cards.name: Marker
cards.meaningCore: A marker you placed. Use it.
cards.meaningReversed: You ignored your own mark.

cards.name: Peak hold
cards.meaningCore: This remembers a peak that is gone. Don't treat memory as now.
cards.meaningReversed: You are reading a leftover spike as if it were happening.

cards.name: Trough
cards.meaningCore: The quietest it got. That may be the useful part.
cards.meaningReversed: You only collect the loudest moments.

cards.name: Sync
cards.meaningCore: Two things lined up. Treat it as coincidence until you test it.
cards.meaningReversed: You called coincidence contact.

cards.name: Phase
cards.meaningCore: Same song, delayed. Don't treat delay as another speaker.
cards.meaningReversed: You thought delay was another speaker.

cards.name: Offset
cards.meaningCore: A shift. Recenter the question.
cards.meaningReversed: You recentered on a more flattering question.

cards.name: Dropout
cards.meaningCore: The line dropped. Re-establish, or stop.
cards.meaningReversed: You kept talking into a dead line.

cards.name: Squelch
cards.meaningCore: A gate that hides noise. If you opened it all the way, of course it howls.
cards.meaningReversed: You opened the gate and blamed the dark.
